source: dt25 g2-OSH-1: a gateway.toml that sets TLS cert/key without client_ca_path, OIDC or gateway_jwt, and no gateway.env. The packaged launchers (deb user unit, Homebrew wrapper) always set OPENSHELL_LOCAL_TLS_DIR, and openshell-gateway 0.0.116 then logs "gateway-minted sandbox JWT enabled" and rejects calls without credentials (verified with a scratch gateway on the test box), so the gateway is not unauthenticated
